description: The Taifoon Commerce Protocol (DRAFT 1.0-draft.1, internal review): the one agentic commerce standard — the parties (buyer, layer, seller, reseller, protocol, venue, evaluator, assurer, settler), the legs a payment leaves as (the one payment scheme, never a second fee rule), the twelve hops of a sale bound to the v2 transitions and the stage register, the vault transitions with receipts, the four queue views, every venue profile with the state each hop has today, and worked agreements whose legs sum to the payment. ?spec=1 returns the draft specification as markdown. Filters: ?venue= ?hop= ?summary=1. Returns: { schema, version, state, rule, sources, counts{ hop_states }, hop_order[], parties[], legs[], hops[], vault_transitions[], queues[], venues[], examples[], conformance, versioning }. (GET /v1/commerce; auth: key-or-operator)

api_key.description: your tfr_ key (optional for keyless reads)

hop.description: the state of one hop across every venue (offer_in … recorded)

summary.description: 1: counts, hop order and the ops only

venue.description: one venue profile by id (x402-base, erc8183-base, moonbeam-acp, …)

name: coord_commerce
